name: First-Two Face Formula
statement: For any order $\pi$ of a finite nonempty class, its width is the maximum of $d_H(a_F,b_F)-1$ over coordinate faces $F$ containing at least two concepts, where $a_F,b_F$ are the first two concepts of $C\cap F$ in the order, together with zero.
proof: A minimal predecessor disagreement $\operatorname{diff}(c,b)$ means that $b,c$ are the first two concepts in their ambient interval face. Conversely, if $a_F,b_F$ are first in a face, an earlier proper subdisagreement would supply a concept of that face before $b_F$. These two correspondences preserve the disagreement size.
